text_block_list.text:
And here's Эйр Грув, in an
awe-inspiring burst
of speed! I can't
believe it! She's overtaken
Silence
Suzuka!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Эйр Грув!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Woo! Эйр Грув, you're the bomb!

Congratulations!
text_block_list.name: Male Fan

text_block_list.text:
Oh my goodness! Эйр Грув, that was

mind-blowing! Thank you so much!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan

text_block_list.text:
Em-press! Em-press! Em-press! Em-press!

Em-press! Em-press!
text_block_list.name: Fans

text_block_list.text: Yes. I...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: (I believe that was a worthy challenge.)
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Эйр Грув!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
You were astounding. ...You completely

outclassed me this time.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Thank you, Suzuka.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
It's because you paved the way ahead of
me...
Because you were stronger than
anyone else...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
That's why I could challenge you with
every last
ounce of energy I had.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I'll never forget this race for as long as I
live.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Me neither.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I'll never forget the sight of you dashing
ahead of
me.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Let's race again someday. We'll have a
rematch
even more exciting than this
one.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув comes back amidst
deafening cheers
resounding all around.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I won. I did it this time.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: That's right.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: You've always believed in me, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
